description:
Resolve layout facts once per distinct checkout context and share those invocation-owned observations with every consumer.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The storage-owned Git module performs at most one layout probe per distinct queried checkout context. Ordinary checkout reads use at most one Git process, external-store startup at most two layout probes, and external listing or lease validation across N queried checkout contexts at most N+1, including the failed data-root probe. Known aliases and repeated consumers reuse observations; lease and issue counts do not multiply probes.
- [hard] REQ-02: Storage, executor, recovery, server, init and hooks share supplied context. Missing context never triggers hidden discovery; data-root selection, external-store coordination and moved or unvisited checkout identities remain correct.
- [hard] REQ-03: The existing counting suite retains ordinary primary/linked issue-read assertions and proves the external-context bounds. Mechanism tests own alias, absent/error-result, clone and concurrency behavior; existing external-store tests retain behavioral ownership.

## Notes

DEC-27 deliberately reconciles the former universal one-process promise while retaining the prohibition on duplicate detection. No direct Git metadata parser, new authority flag or cross-invocation cache is introduced.
title: Layout facts are detected once and reach every consumer
